# Randall Teo — Estate & Legacy Planning, Singapore

> Randall Teo Wei Lun is a Singapore-based Wealth Manager with Prudential Financial Advisers, specialising in estate and legacy planning, Will writing, Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA), CPF structuring and retirement income planning for pre-retirees and retirees. This site publishes plain-English guidance on Singapore estate and retirement rules.

## Core pages
- [About Randall Teo](https://randallteo.sg/): Background, practice focus and how the estate and legacy planning process works.
- [Estate & Legacy](https://randallteo.sg/estate-legacy.html): Guidance hub on Wills, LPAs, CPF nomination, intestacy and estate administration in Singapore.
- [Finance](https://randallteo.sg/finance.html): Guidance hub on CPF, retirement income and cash management in Singapore.
- [Client Stories](https://randallteo.sg/client-stories.html): Anonymised accounts of real planning situations and how they were resolved.
- [Get Started](https://randallteo.sg/get-started.html): How to arrange a consultation.

## Estate & legacy guidance
- [Blended Families and Estate Planning](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-blended-families.html): Standard estate planning assumptions often break down in blended family situations. Here is what to think about and what to do about it.
- [What Happens to Your CPF When You Die?](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-cpf-nomination.html): Your CPF does not follow your Will. Here's what actually happens to your CPF savings when you pass — and what you need to do about it.
- [The Family Conversation Nobody Wants to Have](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-family-conversation.html): Most families avoid talking about money, death and inheritance. The ones who do are far better prepared when something actually happens.
- [What Is a Letter of Administration and When Is It Needed?](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-letter-of-administration.html): Most people have heard of a Will. Far fewer have heard of a Letter of Administration — yet many families end up needing one at the worst possible time.
- [Writing a Letter of Wishes Alongside Your Will](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-letter-of-wishes.html): A Will sets out who gets what. A letter of wishes fills in the gaps — the reasoning, the personal instructions, the things you actually want people to understand.
- [Who Should Be Your Donee?](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-lpa-donee.html): Choosing a donee for your LPA is one of the most important decisions in estate planning. Here's what to consider before you decide.
- [How Does an LPA Actually Work?](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-lpa-how-it-works.html): Common misconceptions about the Lasting Power of Attorney — answered plainly. From activation to what it actually covers.
- [What Happens If You Don't Set Up an LPA?](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-lpa-no-lpa.html): Without an LPA, your family faces a costly and lengthy deputyship process. Here's what that really means — and what it costs.
- [Why Your Will Might Not Mean What You Think](https://randallteo.sg/article-estate-will-misconceptions.html): A Will is not a catch-all document. Here are the most common situations where people discover their Will did not do what they expected.

## Finance & CPF guidance
- [CPF at 55 — What Actually Happens to Your Money?](https://randallteo.sg/article-finance-cpf-at-55.html): A plain-language breakdown of what happens to your CPF at 55 — retirement sums, CPF LIFE plans, and what it means for your retirement.
- [Foreign Currency Holdings in Retirement](https://randallteo.sg/article-finance-foreign-currency.html): Many Singaporeans head into retirement with money in foreign currencies. Here are the risks worth thinking through carefully.
- [Financial Recap — H1 2026](https://randallteo.sg/article-finance-h1-2026.html): A review of major global market events and trends shaping H1 2026, together with a focused analysis of PRULink top and bottom fund performers.
- [What Should You Do With Idle Cash?](https://randallteo.sg/article-finance-idle-cash.html): Comparing SSBs, T-bills, money market funds and fixed deposits — and why the bigger question is what your idle cash should be doing for your future.
- [How to Build a Retirement Income Ladder in Singapore](https://randallteo.sg/article-finance-income-ladder.html): Different income sources that kick in at different times, each doing a different job. Here is how a retirement income ladder works in Singapore.
- [Retirement Income — How Much Is Actually Enough?](https://randallteo.sg/article-finance-retirement-income.html): Most people guess at a retirement number. Here is a clearer way to think about what you actually need and where it should come from.
- [Your Whole Life Plan Between 55 and 65](https://randallteo.sg/article-finance-whole-life-review.html): As you approach retirement, your whole life plan may need a second look. Here's what changes between 55 and 65 and what your options are.
